_comment: Running handoff doc 02 for Copilot after Codex accepted Claude follow-up 02. This is the deploy/live-proof handoff to close W4 SIT end-to-end.
title: Deploy and prove W4 SIT end-to-end vertical slice after Codex Review 02 acceptance
lane: Copilot - CI/CD process, deploy, live runtime verification, closeout proof
objective: Take the accepted repo-side W4 E2E fixes through the official Openclaw CI/CD process and prove the live SIT product shell is usable end-to-end or honestly deferred. Do not close from route health, local mocks, or static parity markers alone.

procedures: Read the CI/CD README before starting.
Use Procedure E if batching multiple W4 fixes into one sprint deploy.
Use Procedure A for a single deployable code change.
Use Procedure C if live SIT differs from repo/local proof.
non_negotiables: No direct VPS modifications. SSH is read-only diagnosis only.
All changes go through local edit -> Git commit -> push -> GitHub Actions deploy -> verify.
Deployment triggers and monitoring must target Piboonsak/Openclaw as the control plane.
Do not close without commit SHA, workflow run URL, automated health proof, and browser clickthrough proof.
Separate route health from user-flow success in the final report.

preconditions: Read `docs/requirement/phaseII/epic-10/W4-SIT-E2E-CODEX-REVIEW-02.md` first. This review accepts the Claude follow-up and sends the work to Copilot.

`npm run verify:w4-html` must pass before deploy-close. If it fails because `index.html` is stale, sync/repair `src/frontend/index.html` against the accepted `src/frontend/main-ux-ui.html` surface before deploying or as part of the same controlled change.
what_to_do: 1. Follow the Openclaw CI/CD procedure in order. Do not skip steps.
2. Confirm the deployable ref/SHA and reconcile the accepted Claude completion reports with the actual git diff.

3. Run or review required pre-deploy checks. At minimum confirm `npm run verify:w4-html`, focused backend/API tests if needed, and the relevant local clickthrough evidence already documented by Claude/Codex.
4. If `npm run verify:w4-html` fails, fix the `index.html` parity gap before deploying. Do not deploy-close with this guard failing.
5. Deploy only through the Openclaw control-plane workflow.
6. After deploy, verify live runtime services, backend health, and public/auth routes.
7. Run a credentialed browser clickthrough on live SIT. Do not stop at HTTP 200.
8. Capture API/network behavior for Company, User, Template/Configurator, Export, and the review-path controls touched in the Claude follow-up.
9. Confirm `/phase2/prototype` and `/index.html` do not contradict each other in the accepted W4 proof path.
10. Return a closeout result with deployed SHA, workflow URL, health proof, browser proof, residual issues, and PASS/BLOCKED.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Login/session
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Can enter the SIT review surface with the intended credential/session state; auth behavior is understood and documented.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Companies
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Add/Edit Company persists through refresh/re-login, or the UI is visibly deferred with no fake success.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Company settings COA/AP/AR
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: COA/AP/AR/settings surfaces are separate and honest; import/add controls are real or clearly deferred.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Users
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Add/Edit User persists through refresh/re-login, or the UI is visibly deferred with no fake success.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Templates / Configurator
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Configurator tabs/actions click without ReferenceError; save/update/preview are real or clearly deferred.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Export
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Quick Export preview/download use the null-template backend path, and Template Export sends runtime column overrides.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Upload/Processing/Review
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: Visible controls are real, fixture-labeled, or deferred honestly; the Claude follow-up controls must not show fake success.

required_live_clickthrough.name: Route parity
required_live_clickthrough.expectation: `/phase2/prototype` and `/index.html` present the same accepted W4 UX surface.

runtime_checks: Public route status for `/phase2/prototype` and `/index.html`, with auth behavior noted.
Backend health endpoints using approved GET checks.
Container/service status or logs only through read-only diagnosis if needed.
Observed API calls during live clickthrough for Company/User/Template/Export paths.
Browser console errors and failed network requests.
acceptance_criteria: Openclaw deploy workflow completed for the intended ref/SHA.
Workflow run URL and deployed SHA are recorded.
`npm run verify:w4-html` passes for the deployed change set.
Automated health checks pass or any failure is explicitly classified and blocking.
Live browser clickthrough covers the W4 product-shell proof path.
Company/User actions are proven persisted or visibly deferred on live SIT.
No visible W4 proof-path action shows success without backend success.
Export/Configurator behavior remains correct after deploy.
`/phase2/prototype` and `/index.html` do not contradict the accepted W4 surface.
Final report clearly says PASS or BLOCKED with evidence.
blocked_exit_conditions: Backend services or DB/Redis dependencies are down for the proof path.
Company/User still show fake-success behavior on live SIT.
Export/Configurator regresses from the accepted W4 backend wiring.
The deployed SHA does not include the accepted Claude fixes.
Workflow passes but browser clickthrough fails.
`npm run verify:w4-html` still fails and parity was not repaired.
final_instruction_to_copilot: Close W4 SIT only with deployed-runtime proof and browser-level evidence. Route 200, local mocks, and stale index/main mismatch are not enough.
